question: The function of vitamin A is/are related to which of the following?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Vitamin A" -> "exists in several forms" -> "includes retinol" -> "includes retinal" -> "includes retinoic acids" -> "all forms are functionally related" -> 95%

CHAIN: "Vitamin A" -> "involved in gene expression" -> "retinoic acids act as hormones" -> "regulate transcription of target genes" -> "includes retinol and retinal in metabolic pathways" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Vitamin A" -> "supports immune function" -> "retinol and retinoic acids play roles in immune response" -> "all forms contribute to overall health" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Vitamin A" -> "important for skin health" -> "retinoic acids promote cell turnover" -> "retinol is used in dermatological treatments" -> "all forms have dermatological relevance" -> 88%
analysis: Vitamin A is a group of fat-soluble compounds that include retinol, retinal, and retinoic acids, all of which play crucial roles in vision, growth, immune function, and cellular communication. Therefore, all the options listed are functions related to vitamin A.
